_comment: Routing expectations for the fictional AcmeSwap sample knowledge base. 'answerable' questions must be answered from the named file. 'handoff' questions are about topics the sample data deliberately does not document and must go to a human. 'known_misses' are answerable in principle, but the word-matching retriever is not confident enough, so they are handed off too: a lost answer, never a wrong one.
